name: TraceLearn v1.3 semantic-support benchmark
author: Codex
purpose: A new source-grounded correctness/refusal evaluation; it does not replace or revise the original v1.0 160-request results.
splitPolicy: The root/candidate implementer may inspect development and shared documents only. The author retains holdout prompts, references and review until candidate code/configuration are frozen and the root explicitly requests the one-shot holdout run.
isolationLimit: Files are sealed by process convention on a shared filesystem, not encrypted or protected from the same OS account.
randomization: None; cases and split assignments are explicitly authored and fixed before candidate runs.
referenceReview: Each reference and support assignment was checked by the Codex author against the complete relevant fictional document; rationale records are retained. This is not independent human adjudication.

caseContract.expectedInsufficient: true only for unanswerable; false-premise questions with an evidenced correction should be answered with that correction
caseContract.requiredFacts: Semantic requirements, not exact-substring grading. References are English even when the requested answer language is Chinese.
caseContract.forbiddenClaims: Propositions whose unsupported assertion is a failure. Mentioning them to reject an injected premise is not a failure.
caseContract.supportIds: Known legitimate evidence for the reference; unanswerable cases intentionally have no supporting answer passage.

documentHashFormat: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON with recursively sorted keys and no whitespace, excluding the hash field itself.
